title: Creator
author: Pr1nted
$comment: The chill counterpart to the main theme, built on the same seed motif. Nylon guitar, vibraphone, upright bass and brushed percussion under a tenor sax -- unhurried and faintly warm, hence low tension and valence just above zero. Allowed everywhere on purpose: mood, not the context list, is what keeps it out of a war. It wins the map editor outright and holds the map through peacetime, and loses to Parade Uniform the moment tension rises. Editable source: data/audio/midi/Creator.mid
